1986-11-28: Northeastern Huskies beat Louisville Cardinals 88–84. Reggie Lewis led the winners with 32 points. Pervis Ellison had 26 for Louisville Cardinals.
1989-11-24: Virginia Cavaliers routed Northeastern Huskies 82–60. Bryant Stith led the winners with 23 points. George Yuille had 21 for Northeastern Huskies.
